Contact us

Questions about a prescription, a service or a product? Call Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair on (07) 5592 2099, email us, or pop in. We’re on the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre in Broadbeach, open 7 days and until 9pm on Thursdays.

Directions, parking and public holiday hours.

Want to send a script ahead?

Send your eScript ahead through the MedAdvisor app or the Priceline Pharmacy app and choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair, or show us the QR code at the prescription counter. More about prescriptions.

Need to see a doctor?

Help Medical is an independent general practice located inside our store. Call (07) 5619 3818 or book at helpmedical.au.

Which email should I use?

Email info@pricelinepf.com.au for general enquiries, or pharmacy@pricelinepf.com.au for prescription and medicine questions, and we’ll get back to you as soon as we can. For anything urgent about your medicines, please call us. In an emergency, call 000.
